desc:
Welcome to Copy The Drawing! 🎨
Try and draw the image as accurately as you can to not get eliminated! 😱

🖌️ Every round, you're given a image and have a limited time to draw it as accurate as you can. ⏳
👀 Then, MR Bucket will pick who's drawing is least accurate, And will be ELIMITED! 💀

💥 Are you ready for the challenge?
 Like ❤️ and favorite ⭐

Inappropriate drawings may result in a ban.
